race.comment: YELLOWKNIFE (4) finds a very winnable race. She's having her fifth run in her maiden campaign but is racing well, winning her maiden three back then just finding one better in two runs since. This is a relatively thin field all things considered and she'll be very hard to catch. RUSSIAN BENEFITS (7) doesn't win out of turn but is going okay, close up at Moe last time out. It's worth noting both career wins have come over this track and distance. PULL MY FINGER (6) is racing well, the past couple over this trip. He'll get back but be running on. DIAMANDA (2) is a picnic champion who carried a whopping 79.5kg to win at Cranbourne last time. She's capable of running a race up to this level.
